Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning jurisdictional public highway transfers between a city or county and the state.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to jurisdictional public highway transfers betweena city or county and the state; adding a new section to chapter 35.21RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: It is the intent of the legislature that apublic water or sewer utility district be absolved of theresponsibility of paying for upgrades to or the removal or deactivationof existing buried pipelines under public highways that have come undercontrol of the state, as long as the buried pipelines met applicablestandards as established at the time of installation.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.21 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Upon the jurisdictional transfer of a public highway from city orcounty control to state control, the state must assume allresponsibility with respect to the upgrade, deactivation, or removal ofexisting water or sewer pipelines beneath the public highway, providedthat the pipelines met the applicable standards and requirements p. 1 HB 1894established by the transferring jurisdiction at the time ofinstallation.
